name: github-issue
description: File a GitHub issue with gh, and hand its number and URL to the next node

env.name: GH_TOKEN
env.description: Only needed when gh is not already logged in; gh's own auth is used otherwise

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Markdown body. A whole ${node.result} is the usual thing to put here

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: OWNER/REPO. Empty uses whatever repo the connector directory sits in

inputs.name: labels
inputs.description: Comma-separated label names. Labels the repo does not have make gh refuse

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Link to the issue, for a later node to quote

outputs.name: number
outputs.description: The issue number on its own, e.g. for a branch name
